content.comment_body: Hello! Why am I getting incorrect links in the UDF when attempting to create one directly from a diagram?

If you copy sections of an FBD diagram and then paste them into a UDF, the references aren't transferred. This has always been the case. Is it a bug or was it designed to be this way? Only [company_name] could clarify this.
I don't copy; rather, I select a part of the diagram and use the 'Create UDF' feature.
When I use this function as well, I haven't encountered any issues. Please see the attached screen video.
This is the result I get.
I reinstalled [product_name]. Everything is working properly now.

analysis.insight_summary: A user experienced incorrect linking when generating a UDF from a diagram using [product_name]. Another participant noted reference issues occur when copying and pasting segments in FBD diagrams, which seems intentional or long-standing. However, the 'Create UDF' tool appears to function as expected. The issue was resolved for the original poster after reinstalling the software, implying the cause may have been a local installation or configuration problem.
analysis.user_expectations: The user would like the 'Create UDF' function in [product_name] to correctly link and reference diagram elements when creating a UDF, without introducing incorrect connections.
